question.text: An Employee Option Pool of 15% of total capital in a startup:

answer.text: Has no impact on AIF investors once the investment is made
Is prohibited under SEBI (AIF) Regulations for Cat II AIF investees
Can dilute the AIF investor's stake if employees exercise their options; the typical ideal option pool for an Indian startup is 5-10% of capital
Only dilutes founder equity, never investor equity

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 11.6.7 (Extent of Option Pool), if employees exercise their stock options, it may dilute investor stakes as well (not only founders). The chapter states an ideal option pool for Indian startups is 5-10% of capital. At 15%, the pool is above the ideal range. The Trap: Options do impact AIFs (via dilution). SEBI does not prohibit ESOPs. Option D ignores the math — options dilute all shareholders pro-rata unless structured otherwise.
